description: JUnit test class for the PersonAttribute class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods like toString(), equalsContent(), getHydratedObject(), and voidAttribute().

classes.name: PersonAttributeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing various functionalities of PersonAttribute.

methods.name: toString_shouldReturnToStringOfHydratedValue
methods.description: Tests that the toString() method returns the expected string for a hydrated PersonAttribute.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnTrueIfAttributeTypeValueAndVoidStatusAreTheSame
methods.description: Checks that equalsContent() returns true when two PersonAttributes have the same type, value, and voided status.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldLoadClassInFormatProperty
methods.description: Tests that getHydratedObject() correctly loads a Concept instance based on a class specified in format.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldLoadUserClassInFormatProperty
methods.description: Ensures getHydratedObject() loads a User instance when format specifies 'org.openmrs.User'.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldStillLoadClassInFormatPropertyIfNotAttributable
methods.description: Verifies getHydratedObject() returns the raw string value when format is 'java.lang.String'.

methods.name: voidAttribute_shouldSetVoidedBitToTrue
methods.description: Checks that calling voidAttribute() sets the voided flag to true.
